about_the_game:
This DLC gives a lot of fun from the very beginning. It won't give you any superpower, but will let you skip some early stages of the game and get faster to the more advanced combat. Also it gives you a "no trouble with silver" feature, thus you'll be able to play with VIP-class comfort!

The DLC contains
  • Premium tank: Sherman
  • 40 000 of silver
You will receive it once you've entered the game.

Note: If you're using several game accounts, the DLC will be delivered to the first game account you'll log in, after the purchase of the DLC.
